The '''62nd [[Writers Guild of America Award]]s''' honored the best [[film writer|film]], [[television writer|television]], and [[Television writer#Video game writing|videogame writers]] of 2009. Winners were announced on February 20, 2010.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://awards.wga.org/awards/nominees-winners/2012-2006 |title=Writers Guild Awards Winners: 2012-2006 |work=wga.org |publisher=Writers Guild of America |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251228141617/https://awards.wga.org/awards/nominees-winners/2012-2006 |archive-date=2025-12-28 |access-date=2026-02-20 |url-status=live }}</ref>


==Nominees==
Names in '''bold''' denote the winners.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.imdb.com/event/ev0000710/2010/1/|title=Writers Guild of America, USA (2010)|website=IMDb|access-date=2026-02-20}}</ref>
